name: .400 Cal-350gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist rate for big game hunting is 1-16″ and dangerous game hunting is 1-14″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This is our heaviest Stone Hammer™ designed for the 400 Tembo. Use these for all of your dangerous game hunting as well as any other big game."
